title: Fro
summary: FRO, adverb [In some languages it is a prefix, having the force of a negative.] FROm; away; back or backward; as in the phrase, to and fro that is, to and from, forward or toward and backward, hither

inlines.v: FRO, adverb [In some languages it is a prefix, having the force of a negative.] FROm; away; back or backward; as in the phrase, to and fro that is, to and from, forward or toward and backward, hither and thither.
